# Fighter Animation Pack gallery assets

The licensed binary assets in this folder are gitignored.

Installation root: `assets/third_party/fighter_animation_pack/`

- `anims/*.fbx`: all 313 FBX actions from
  `C:\uworks\AssetsSource\Fighter_Animation_Pack\FBX`
- `model.fbx` and `tex/9CG.png`: the pack's compatible display model

Three action filenames occur twice in different source directories. Those six files retain
their relative source path in the flattened destination filename so no animation is overwritten.
